brief: Apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure before the forecast heat event, as outlined in MG-023. For sustained events exceeding 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward in accordance with MG-021. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified as specified in MG-021.
